quote_control.title: Quote & Price Control Agent
quote_control.description: Supports price checks, configuration review, and quote estimates.
quote_control.section_sku_master_description: Load Deep Trekker manufacturer price books by SKU and review price, description, and notes changes.
quote_control.previous_master_hint: Upload only when comparing. This does not apply changes to the official master.
quote_control.import_error: The price book could not be loaded.
quote_control.no_import: No price book has been loaded yet.
quote_control.section_spaceone_reconcile_description: Match the internal master to DT40 / PT30 by SKU. Cell positions are not used. Nothing is applied.
quote_control.reconcile_not_applied: This review does not rewrite the SpaceOne master.
quote_control.no_reconcile: Internal master reconciliation has not been run yet.
quote_control.reconcile_missing_files: Select the SpaceOne master and DT40 or PT30.
quote_control.reconcile_error: The internal master could not be reconciled.
quote_control.recommended_change_caption: Recommended changes are shown only. They are not applied.
quote_control.section_pricing_policy_description: Extract policy candidates from SpaceOne master sales formulas. Official sales prices are not changed.
quote_control.pricing_policy_not_applied: Simulation only. SpaceOne standard sales prices are not rewritten. Shipping / insurance / tax are excluded.
quote_control.no_pricing_policies: Run SpaceOne master reconciliation first to extract sales formulas.
quote_control.exchange_rate_invalid: Enter a numeric exchange rate. 160/170 is not a hardcoded rule.
quote_control.debug_fx_not_applied: Scenario analysis only. This rate and its results are not applied to quote drafts, standard sales candidates, approvals or formal quotes. Set the quote exchange rate in the main screen.

price_masters.management_description: Import manufacturer price books, the SpaceOne price master and the quote-calc policy. Any file name is fine. A file becomes active only after validation succeeds and is used for new quotes. Existing and approved quotes do not change.

labels.QUOTE_CALC: Quote-calc policy (import tax, insurance, shipping markup)

outcomes.ACTIVATED: {label} was imported and activated ({file}). It is used for new quotes. Existing quotes do not change.
outcomes.ALREADY_ACTIVE: The same {label} is already active. Nothing new was imported.
outcomes.REACTIVATED: The previously imported identical {label} (imported {date}) is active again.
outcomes.NOT_XLSX: Choose an Excel (.xlsx) file for {label}. The current price master was not changed.
outcomes.VALIDATION_FAILED: The file could not be read as {label}. Check the file. The current price master was not changed.
outcomes.MASTER_TYPE_UNCONFIRMED: The file could not be confirmed as {label}. Check which price book you selected (for example DT40 vs PT30). The current price master was not changed.
outcomes.POLICY_INCOMPLETE: Not all required values (import tax, insurance, shipping markup) could be read for {label}. Check the file. The current price master was not changed.
outcomes.STORAGE_FAILED: Saving {label} failed. The current price master was not changed.

quote_control.scenario_exchange_rate_label: Scenario-only exchange rate (JPY/USD, not applied to quotes)
quote_control.detected_rate_caption: Detected on the master: {rate} (reference only, not a permanent rule)
quote_control.section_landed_cost_description: Estimate landed cost from project FX, import tax, insurance, and shipping. Manufacturer prices and SpaceOne standard sales prices are not recalculated.
quote_control.landed_cost_not_applied: Simulation only. This does not finalize a quote, approve a policy, or auto-adopt a shipping rule.
quote_control.import_tax_basis_caption: The quote-calc sheet taxes dealer JPY (PRODUCT_DEALER_JPY). The engine uses the entered rate.
quote_control.domestic_shipping_caption: Domestic shipping allocation differs by sheet. The 5,000-yen note is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
quote_control.quote_calc_detected_caption: Quote-calc detected: tax H×{tax} / insurance H×{insurance} / shipping sales ×{markup} / domestic {domestic}
quote_control.landed_no_products: Use linked SKUs or a Golden IHI scenario.
quote_control.ihi_landed_hint: Product cost uses Current Dealer. Sales use SalesPriceCandidate. Historical values are comparison only.
quote_control.section_quote_builder_description: Assemble a quote draft with internal BOM and customer lines kept separate. Approval happens in the review section below.
quote_control.quote_builder_hint: Development launch from the IHI golden case. Historical prices are preview only.
quote_control.remarks_caption: Golden historical snapshot only. Current lead time is not updated.
quote_control.section_quote_approval_description: Do not trust a UI READY flag. The approval service revalidates and freezes an immutable snapshot.
quote_control.select_remarks_label: Remarks to include in the approved snapshot
quote_control.approval_blocked: Approval is blocked. Resolve critical warnings.
quote_control.approval_ready: Revalidation passed. The quote can be approved.
quote_control.approved_draft_locked: An approved draft cannot be edited. Create a new version.
quote_control.auto_valid_until_label: Set valid-until to one calendar month after the issue date
quote_control.section_file_export_description: Files are generated only from the Approved Snapshot. Master and Draft are not recalculated.
quote_control.official_quote_number_caption: Numbers are not auto-assigned. Development filenames use the quote number candidate.
quote_control.export_requires_snapshot: Files cannot be generated without an Approved Snapshot.
quote_control.export_requires_official: A formal customer quote Excel requires an official quote number.
quote_control.no_export_yet: No files have been generated yet.

workspace.header_empty: Create a quote draft to see the case summary.

price_sources.DEVELOPMENT_REFERENCE: Development reference price (not an official price book)

price_states.DEVELOPMENT_REFERENCE: No official price book / review required

workspace.price_source_blocked: Official price book is not set ({count} lines). This quote is internal reference only and cannot be approved or issued as a formal quote. Import the official manufacturer price book and recreate the draft.
workspace.fx_new_input_label: Exchange rate for the new quote (JPY / USD)
workspace.fx_default_hint: The standard simulation rate is {default} JPY/USD. Change it when the case requires.
workspace.fx_apply_hint: Recalculates dealer JPY, import tax, insurance, landed cost, shipping cost and standard sales candidates with the same rate. Candidates that cannot be recalculated are cleared. Final prices are not changed.
workspace.fx_invalid: Enter an exchange rate greater than 0.
workspace.fx_locked: The exchange rate of an approved quote cannot be changed. Create a revision.
workspace.fx_reprice_failed: Cost recalculation failed. The exchange rate was not changed.
workspace.unresolved_dependency: A required component is unresolved. Choose the customer presentation.
workspace.approval_not_checked: Approval readiness has not been checked yet.
workspace.approval_needs: Approval still requires the following checks.
workspace.export_needs_approval: File export requires an approved snapshot.
workspace.submitted_recorded: Recorded as submitted to the customer.
workspace.already_submitted: This quote is already recorded as submitted.
workspace.no_current_step_detail: This step is available after a quote draft is created.
workspace.pending_price_key_ambiguous: Pending sales price for SKU {sku} was not restored because this quote has multiple lines with that SKU. Enter the value on each line.

warning_kinds.margin: Gross margin is pending because the draft is incomplete
warning_kinds.stale_candidate: Standard sales candidate needs recalculation (rate differs or unknown): {count}
warning_kinds.sales_master: SpaceOne price master not set (no standard sales candidate): {count}
warning_kinds.fx_final_kept: Case sales price kept after rate change: {count}
warning_kinds.fx_diverged: Standard and case sales price differ: {count}

workspace.resume_failed: The draft could not be opened.
workspace.fx_market_title: Market reference rate (reference only, not used in calculation)
workspace.fx_market_invalid: Enter the market reference rate and buffer as numbers.
workspace.fx_adopted_title: Quote exchange rate (used for this quote)
workspace.fx_metadata_saved: Exchange rate record saved. The quote exchange rate did not change.
workspace.fx_rate_changed_notice: Costs and standard sales prices were updated with the quote exchange rate. Case sales prices were not changed.
workspace.fx_final_kept_lines: Lines that kept the case sales price: {items}
workspace.fx_diverged_lines: Lines where the standard and case sales prices differ: {items}. Review the case sales price if needed.

standard_review_reasons.ambiguous_candidates: Several price candidates exist for the same SKU
standard_review_reasons.msrp_mismatch: Manufacturer price and pricing policy do not match
standard_review_reasons.stale_rate: Standard price at the quote rate is not calculated yet
standard_review_reasons.sales_master_missing: SpaceOne price master is not set
standard_review_reasons.not_calculable: Standard sales price cannot be calculated

workspace.standard_unset_note: Standard price is not decided. Enter the case sales price manually.
workspace.adjustment_reason_label: Adjustment reason (required when different from the standard price)

adjustment_errors.amount_invalid: Enter the case sales price as a number of 0 or more.
adjustment_errors.reason_required: Select an adjustment reason because the price differs from the standard price.
adjustment_errors.note_required: Enter a note when Other is selected.

workspace.adjustment_unchanged: The same entry is already saved.
workspace.customer_price_title: Standard sales price → Case sales price
workspace.margin_title: Gross margin (landed cost basis, whole quote)

quote_control.ihi_pricing_comparison_hint: IHI customer quotes are historical output, not a pricing policy source.
quote_control.manual_sku_link_label: Manual SKU link for review items
quote_control.manual_sku_link_hint: Similar SKUs are not auto-corrected. Enter a SKU that exists in DT40 / PT30.
quote_control.section_update_inbox_description: Organize Dealer Updates, direct emails, WhatsApp notes, and meetings as candidates. They are not official until a person reviews them.
quote_control.no_previous_master: No previous master is available, so differences are not shown.
quote_control.diff_not_applied: This screen is for review only. The official SKU master is not updated yet.
quote_control.golden_quote_cases_hint: Not a customer-facing UI. These are acceptance-test fixtures.
quote_control.golden_supplier_not_sot: Validation target (not Manufacturer Source of Truth)
quote_control.golden_validate_button: Validate IHI Supplier Quote against DT40 / PT30
quote_control.golden_validation_hint: Run validation to compare the Supplier Quote with the manufacturer books.
quote_control.golden_validation_no_books: DT40 / PT30 manufacturer books are not available, so validation is not shown.
quote_control.golden_validation_caption: DT40 / PT30 are the manufacturer price source of truth. Supplier Quote prices are not adopted as cost.

activity_ledger.title: Activity Ledger
activity_ledger.description: Review inquiries, quotes, derived work, and other activity in chronological order.
activity_ledger.preview_note: Shows the approved snapshot. Current price master is not recalculated.
